{"fetched_at":"2026-06-12","jd_text":"Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
Location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role
As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic’s products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities
- Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
- Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic’s GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
- Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
- Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
- Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
- Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic’s products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have
- 7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
- 3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
- Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
- Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
- Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
- Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
- A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have
- 5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
- Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience.
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience.
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position.
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, Anthropic expects all staff to be in one of its offices at least 25% of the time. Some roles may require more time in office.
Visa sponsorship: Anthropic says it sponsors visas but cannot successfully sponsor every role and candidate.

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (GTM context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s public identity combines frontier AI research with a public-benefit orientation centered on reliable, interpretable, and steerable systems. That creates a higher bar for external deployment work: partner-led implementations must
translate model capability into production value without diluting trust, security, or safety expectations.

The operating tension is scaling enterprise adoption through external delivery organizations while preserving consistent technical standards, product feedback quality, and Anthropic’s differentiated safety posture.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a hybrid research, product, and platform company: it develops AI systems and commercializes them through Claude products and developer-facing access.

Its dominant commercial motion is increasingly enterprise and ecosystem enabled rather than services-led. Anthropic supplies the core AI product and platform; cloud, technology, and services partners expand reach, implementation capacity,
and industry context.

The central tension is between fast ecosystem scale and controlled customer outcomes. Partners must be empowered to build and deploy independently while remaining aligned to Anthropic’s product capabilities, technical guidance, and
responsible-AI positioning.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation founded in 2021, with a company mission focused on reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. That governance and mission framing are strategically material: enterprise adoption is not
solely a distribution problem, but also a trust and deployment-quality problem.

Claude is positioned for complex problem solving, including analysis and coding work. This makes adoption depend less on generic AI awareness and more on converting broad model capability into repeatable workflows, architectures, and
measurable production outcomes.

The operating-model pressure is to turn field learning into reusable assets. As partner and customer implementations diversify, decision rights around reference patterns, technical exceptions, escalation, and product feedback need to become
clearer and more scalable.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Anthropic was founded by Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei. Its public company positioning emphasizes the combination of research, engineering, policy, and business functions.

The relevant stakeholder map likely spans:
- Partnerships and commercial leadership, which set ecosystem priorities and joint-market motions.
- Product and engineering, which need structured feedback from real deployment constraints.
- Research and safety-oriented functions, which shape the company’s differentiated responsible-development posture.
- Cloud, technology, and services partners, which extend route-to-market and implementation capacity.
- Enterprise technical buyers and delivery leaders, who require credible production architectures rather than model demonstrations alone.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic’s core product identity is Claude, an AI assistant positioned as safe, accurate, and secure. Its broader company mission emphasizes reliability, interpretability, and steerability rather than capability alone.

That positioning makes architecture credibility especially important. Enterprise adoption requires practical guidance on how Claude fits into existing applications, workflows, data environments, developer practices, and security
expectations.

The meaningful architecture signal is not merely model access; it is the ability to operationalize a trusted AI platform through repeatable implementation patterns. The company’s research orientation also raises the importance of
disciplined feedback loops between market deployments and product teams.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly presents a partner network spanning cloud, technology, and services partners. This indicates an ecosystem motion designed to address customer challenges through more than direct product access.

The partnership DNA is likely strongest where partners can combine Anthropic’s AI capabilities with their own cloud footprint, industry knowledge, implementation teams, software products, or customer relationships.

Key ecosystem requirements include:
- Co-selling with consistent technical qualification and solution narratives.
- Partner enablement that creates durable capability beyond one-off deal support.
- Joint solution development that turns recurring customer needs into reusable patterns.
- Technical closing support where architecture, security, integration, and adoption risk determine deal velocity.
- Product feedback mechanisms that distinguish isolated requests from scalable platform needs.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s public partner positioning signals a material expansion of the company’s enterprise adoption surface area: cloud, technology, and services firms can multiply customer reach, but also multiply implementation variance.

The urgency is therefore operational as much as commercial. As the ecosystem grows, Anthropic needs partner-delivered experiences to remain technically credible and consistent with its safety-centered brand.

Competitive pressure across enterprise AI is also shifting value toward the companies that can move from model evaluation to deployed workflows fastest. Ecosystem execution, not only model performance, becomes a differentiator.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Building repeatable partner enablement, certification, and field-readiness systems.
- Translating AI platform capabilities into secure production architectures.
- Creating joint solutions with cloud, services, and technology partners.
- Improving technical-win consistency in partner-led enterprise opportunities.
- Establishing feedback loops from deployments into product and engineering roadmaps.
- Balancing commercial acceleration with responsible-AI, trust, and quality standards.
- Turning bespoke implementation knowledge into reusable reference patterns.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s challenge appears to be ecosystem-scale deployment quality, not simply partner recruitment.
- The cloud, technology, and services partner network makes repeatable technical enablement strategically important.
- Claude’s enterprise value depends on moving from experimentation to integrated workflows and durable adoption.
- Anthropic’s safety and reliability positioning raises the bar for partner-delivered customer outcomes.
- The most interesting operating question is how field deployment learning becomes product and architecture leverage.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume and proof graph.
